```{r}
#| include: false
library(reticulate)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C"))
reticulate::py_require("kagglehub")
```

```{python}
#| include: false
import kagglehub
path = kagglehub.dataset_download("mmumairkhattak/google-stock-and-search-trends-2021-2025")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
data <- read.csv(file.path(py$path, "google_trends_and_stock_2021_2025.csv"))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date),
         Year = format(Date, "%Y"))

start_price <- head(data$Stock_Close, 1)
final_price <- tail(data$Stock_Close, 1)
change      <- round((final_price - start_price) / start_price * 100, 1)
correlation <- round(cor(data$Search_Trend_AI, data$Stock_Close), 2)
```

# Overview

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Final closing price ($)"
#| icon: currency-dollar
#| color: primary
list(value = round(final_price, 2))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Change 2021-2025"
#| icon: graph-up-arrow
#| color: success
list(value = paste0(change, " %"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average daily volume (shares)"
#| icon: bar-chart
#| color: info
list(value = paste0(round(mean(data$Volume) / 1e6, 1), "M"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "AI searches vs. price correlation"
#| icon: search
#| color: warning
list(value = correlation)
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Closing price over time"
f1 <- ggplot(data , aes(Date, Stock_Close, group = 1,
                       text = paste0("Date: ", format(Date, "%b %d, %Y"),
                                     "Closing price: $", round(Stock_Close, 2)))) +
  geom_line(color = "orange") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Closing price ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(f1, tooltip = "text")
```

## Row {height="35%"}

### Column {.tabset width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Searches: AI vs. Cloud"
f2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Search_Trend_AI, color = "AI", group = 1,
                text = paste0("Date: ", format(Date, "%b %d, %Y"), "AI searches: ", Search_Trend_AI))) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Search_Trend_Cloud, color = "Cloud", group = 1,
                text = paste0("Date: ", format(Date, "%b %d, %Y"), "Cloud searches: ", Search_Trend_Cloud))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("AI" = "violet", "Cloud" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Search interest", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(f2, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Average volume per year"
f4 <- data %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(volume = mean(Volume) / 1e6) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Year, volume,
             text = paste0("Year: ", Year, ">Average volume: ", round(volume, 1), " million"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "salmon") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average volume (millions)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(f4, tooltip = "text")
```

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "More AI searches = higher price?"
f3 <- ggplot(data, aes(Search_Trend_AI, Stock_Close)) +
  geom_point(aes(text = paste0("Date: ", format(Date, "%b %d, %Y"),
                              "AI searches: ", Search_Trend_AI,
                              "Closing price: $", round(Stock_Close, 2))),
             alpha = 0.3, color = "violet") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "AI searches", y = "Closing price ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(f3, tooltip = "text")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: "Full table"
datatable(data,
          colnames = c("Date", "Open price ($)", "Close price ($)", "Volume",
                       "AI searches", "Cloud searches", "Year"),
          options = list(pageLength = 15))
```
